saw_lines: Bulk snack buyers pick a favorite, then reorder it on a routine. The first order is a trial, reorders make the habit.
So the sale is won or lost at the first click, when a new buyer decides whether a single product is worth trying.
Your 30 live ads show no proof number, so buyers see no count to trust. Lead the next batch with one proof number, such as your review count or orders shipped.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer on KoRo has no count to trust. Collect one, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

3 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product in the creative, so they have to search before ordering. Point each one to the product or collection it shows, like the mango puree or Choco Shells.
Your site lists a bundle, yet 0 of 18 copy ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to act today. Put the bundle in the first line of three new ads, with one set product shown on the creative.

10 different openings run across 18 copy ads, and the biggest one leads only 3. Pick the two strongest, the advent calendar presale and the favorite products line, and build the next batch from them with new variations.

ads_1: Advent calendar and favorite products hooks, each linked to its own product page
